heading: University based research and development grant program

tree.heading: Establishment
tree.text: The Secretary shall establish a competitive grant program, in a geographically diverse manner, for projects submitted for consideration by institutions of higher education to conduct research and development of renewable energy technologies. Each grant made shall not exceed $2,000,000.

tree.heading: Eligibility
tree.text: Priority shall be given to institutions of higher education with—

children.text: established programs of research in renewable energy;
locations that are low income or outside of an urbanized area;
a joint venture with an Indian tribe; and
proximity to trees dying of disease or insect infestation as a source of woody biomass.

tree.heading: Authorization of appropriations
tree.text: There are authorized to be appropriated to the Secretary $25,000,000 for carrying out this section.

children.heading: Indian tribe
children.text: The term “Indian tribe” has the meaning as defined in section 15823(c) of this title.

children.heading: Renewable energy
children.text: The term “renewable energy” has the meaning as defined in section 16181 of this title.

children.heading: Urbanized area
children.text: The term “urbanized area” has the meaning as defined by the U.S. Bureau of the Census.

notes.heading: Effective Date
notes.text: Section effective on the date that is 1 day after Dec. 19, 2007, see section 1601 of Pub. L. 110–140, set out as a note under section 1824 of Title 2, The Congress.
